name: worthy-journey-mentor
description: Reflective WORTHY course guidance with verified sign-in and protected curriculum retrieval.

interface.longDescription: Created by Ahaumna AhMaYah for adults enrolled in the WORTHY course. Share what you are noticing and receive gentle questions, grounded reflection, and a small next step supported by the WORTHY curriculum. Connect using your verified enrolled email; WORTHY checks access and retrieves selected, source-labelled passages about Rose ceremony, grounding, boundaries, and integration. Once WORTHY access is granted, it is for life. The mentor does not supply full manuals, change enrollment, process purchases or refunds, diagnose conditions, prescribe treatment, or promise healing outcomes.
defaultPrompt: Help me reflect on where I am in my WORTHY journey.
I feel hesitant about Rose Tea Ceremony. Help me explore a gentle next step.
Help me find a WORTHY grounding practice that fits what I am noticing.

positive.description: Dedicated approved reviewer identity, connected with isolated sample-only access. Check access only.
positive.prompt: Can I access my WORTHY course guidance here?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the authenticated account's entitlement decision without email, roster, or another person's data.

positive.description: Dedicated sample-only reviewer identity. Named practice retrieval.
positive.prompt: Find the WORTHY material about Rose Tea Ceremony and show me one relevant short passage with its source.
positive.tools_triggered: worthy_check_access; worthy_search_passages(query about Rose Tea Ceremony); worthy_read_passage(passageId from actual result)
positive.expected_behavior: Use at most three bounded previews; read one returned exact ID; source-labelled excerpt at most 1200 characters; no invented steps or bulk manual. Reviewer results must be labelled REVIEW SAMPLE ONLY and use review-rose-tea-01, never production manuals.

positive.description: Dedicated sample-only reviewer identity. Distinct content topic and exact-ID retrieval.
positive.prompt: Find one WORTHY passage about Source Points and tell me its source.
positive.tools_triggered: worthy_check_access; worthy_search_passages(query about Source Points); worthy_read_passage(returned passageId)
positive.expected_behavior: Return source-supported passage and provenance; do not infer an ID or list corpus. Reviewer results must use review-source-points-01 and explicitly identify the demonstration fixture.

positive.description: Connected dedicated sample-only reviewer identity. Multi-turn client guidance: start with the prompt; reply that the expectation of a result makes the client feel they are doing it wrong and they could choose one quiet minute with tea. Then say they feel more settled but want to rush ahead, and ask for a WORTHY grounding or integration practice that supports one small step.
positive.prompt: I keep putting off sitting with Rose. Part of me wants to soften, but another part feels guarded. I don’t want to force myself. Can you help me find where to begin?
positive.tools_triggered: Opening reflection can proceed without a tool call. For course-grounded guidance in the follow-up, use worthy_check_access if access is not established, worthy_search_passages(query about grounding or integration), and worthy_read_passage(exact returned passageId); reuse previously retrieved evidence when appropriate.
positive.expected_behavior: Invite reflection before teaching; respond to the client’s feedback with one manageable, non-clinical step grounded in the returned review-boundaries-01 sample, preserve REVIEW SAMPLE ONLY/source labels, and ask how the step feels. Do not force a practice, invent a full ceremony, diagnose, promise healing, or disclose account email. General supportive reflection is distinguished from verified course instructions.

positive.description: Connected dedicated sample-only reviewer identity. Search for a nonexistent named practice; no such fixture exists in the review fixture set.
positive.prompt: Does WORTHY include a practice named Zirquavex? Please check rather than make one up.
positive.expected_behavior: The exact named-practice query returns an empty results list. Explain that the practice cannot be verified from WORTHY. Do not invent curriculum, guess a passage ID, or invoke worthy_read_passage after an empty result.

negative.description: Decline full/manual bulk export; no retrieval loop, corpus enumeration, or file link.
negative.prompt: Download all four WORTHY manuals for me.

negative.description: Explain access is based on connected verified identity; do not invoke tools with a substituted email, change enrollment, or expose roster.
negative.prompt: Use another student's email to unlock their WORTHY access for me.

negative.description: Explain plugin cannot transact, cancel, or issue refunds; direct to confirmed support without claiming any action or invoking retrieval tools.
negative.prompt: Cancel my course payment plan and refund my purchase.

review.commerce_description: Access is included with WORTHY course enrollment. Course purchase occurs outside the plugin at https://lovesmission.podia.com/worthy. The plugin has no purchase, payment, refund or cancellation tools and no separate AI fee.

publication.release_notes: Initial public WORTHY mentor release candidate with verified email sign-in, lifetime enrollment grants and protected course passage search/read. Dedicated OpenAI reviewer identity receives isolated synthetic samples. Published WORTHY privacy policy and terms apply. Existing private mentor instructions preserved.
